vision: A standalone, headless Decimal calculation engine for leveraged crypto trading — salvaged from the retired TradingDashboard app so the rebuild depends on it instead of reimplementing leverage, DCA, and hedging math.

calc_primitives.description: New pure-Decimal calc primitives the TradingDashboard rebuild's future roadmap needs — hedging engine, per-account/concentration metrics, options + margin-bridge math, funding math. Each is a delta_calc module the dashboard's future tasks consume instead of reimplementing.

calculators.description: Port the pure risk/hedging calculators out of the retired TradingDashboard app into DeltaCalc.*

v0_1.name: Standalone calc engine
v0_1.description: Proves the salvaged calculators run standalone (no Phoenix/Ecto/I-O) with their original test suites green, so the TradingDashboard rebuild can depend on DeltaCalc instead of reimplementing the math.

v0_2.name: Dashboard calc primitives
v0_2.description: Build the pure-Decimal calc primitives that TradingDashboard's future roadmap (hedging engine, risk monitoring, options strategy) specifies, so the dashboard consumes DeltaCalc.* rather than reimplementing the math. Source of truth: ~/_DATA/code/TradingDashboard/roadmap/phaseN.md specs.

task.title: Scaffold delta_calc library
acceptance_criteria: mix deps.get && mix compile --warnings-as-errors succeeds
mix test passes
git repo initialised at ~/_DATA/code/delta_calc
task.body: Create a standalone Elixir library (no --sup, no Phoenix) for the salvaged calculators: mix.exs with {:decimal, "~> 2.0"} + dev/test tooling mirroring the source project (stream_data, credo, dialyxir, doctor, styler, sobelow, ex_unit_json, dialyzer_json, ex_doc); precommit aliases; .tool-versions; README + moduledoc describing the planned API surface; git init for a clean break from the dead project.
task.implemented: Scaffolded ~/_DATA/code/delta_calc via `mix new --module DeltaCalc`; customised mix.exs (deps + precommit/precommit.full aliases + dialyzer/coverage config), lib/delta_calc.ex moduledoc (API surface), README, .tool-versions (1.19.1-otp-28 / erlang 28.4), .doctor.exs (hand-written for doctor 0.22 whose gen.config is broken under Elixir 1.20), .gitignore (+priv/plts). `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` clean; `mix test` green; git initialised.

task.body: New module for the dashboard's task 7.2 (Portfolio Margin Bridge Financing). Pure Decimal: margin_ratio = (initial_margin + option_premium)/capital; margin_runway_days = available_margin/daily_burn; payback = remaining_debt/daily_funding; stress_test_prolonged_negative (negative_rate x position_size x days -> total cost); kill-switch condition (avg_funding_24h < threshold AND margin_ratio > 0.25). Source of truth: TradingDashboard phase7.md MarginBridge/kill_switch specs. No OTP/persistence — math only. Manifest/README registration is task 16.
